empty-text.description: text displayed when data is void
empty-text.description_zh: 内容为空的时候展示的文本

:props.description: configuration options, see the following table

highlight-current.description_zh: 是否高亮当前选中节点

expand-on-click-node.description: whether to expand or collapse node when clicking on the node, if false, then expand or collapse node only when clicking on the arrow icon.
expand-on-click-node.description_zh: 是否在点击节点的时候展开或者收缩节点， 默认值为 true，如果为 false，则只有点箭头图标的时候才会展开或者收缩节点。

check-on-click-node.description: whether to check or uncheck node when clicking on the node, if false, the node can only be checked or unchecked by clicking on the checkbox.
check-on-click-node.description_zh: 是否在点击节点的时候选中节点，默认值为 false，即只有在点击复选框时才会选中节点。

:default-expanded-keys.description: array of keys of initially expanded nodes
:default-expanded-keys.description_zh: 默认展开的节点的 key 的数组

check-strictly.description: whether checked state of a node not affects its father and child nodes when `show-checkbox` is `true`
check-strictly.description_zh: 在显示复选框的情况下，是否严格的遵循父子不互相关联的做法

:default-checked-keys.description: array of keys of initially checked nodes
:default-checked-keys.description_zh: 默认勾选的节点的 key 的数组

:filter-method.description: this function will be executed on each node when use filter method. if return `false`, tree node will be hidden.
:filter-method.description_zh: 对树节点进行筛选时执行的方法，返回 true 表示这个节点可以显示，返回 false 则表示这个节点会被隐藏

:indent.description: horizontal indentation of nodes in adjacent levels in pixels
:indent.description_zh: 相邻级节点间的水平缩进，单位为像素

methods.name: filter
methods.description: filter all tree nodes, filtered nodes will be hidden
methods.description_zh: 对树节点进行筛选操作

methods.name: getCheckedNodes
methods.description: If the node can be selected (`show-checkbox` is `true`), it returns the currently selected array of nodes
methods.description_zh: 若节点可被选择（即 `show-checkbox` 为 `true`），则返回目前被选中的节点所组成的数组

methods.name: getCheckedKeys
methods.description: If the node can be selected (`show-checkbox` is `true`), it returns the currently selected array of node's keys
methods.description_zh: 若节点可被选择（即 `show-checkbox` 为 `true`），则返回目前被选中的节点的 key 所组成的数组

methods.name: setCheckedKeys
methods.description: set certain nodes to be checked

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: set node to be checked or not
methods.description_zh: 通过 key 设置某个节点的勾选状态

methods.name: setExpandedKeys
methods.description: set certain nodes to be expanded

methods.name: getHalfCheckedNodes
methods.description: If the node can be selected (`show-checkbox` is `true`), it returns the currently half selected array of nodes
methods.description_zh: 若节点可被选择（即 `show-checkbox` 为 `true`），则返回目前半选中的节点所组成的数组

methods.name: getHalfCheckedKeys
methods.description: If the node can be selected (`show-checkbox` is `true`), it returns the currently half selected array of node's keys
methods.description_zh: 若节点可被选择（即 `show-checkbox` 为 `true`），则返回目前半选中的节点的 key 所组成的数组

methods.name: getCurrentKey
methods.description: return the highlight node's key (undefined if no node is highlighted)
methods.description_zh: 获取当前被选中节点的 key，若没有节点被选中则返回 undefined

methods.name: getCurrentNode
methods.description: return the highlight node's data (undefined if no node is highlighted)
methods.description_zh: 获取当前被选中节点的数据，若没有节点被选中则返回 undefined

methods.name: setCurrentKey
methods.description_zh: 通过 key 设置某个节点为当前选中节点

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: get node by key or data
methods.description_zh: 根据 data 或者 key 拿到 TreeNode 节点

methods.name: setData
methods.description: When the data is very large, using reactive data will cause the poor performance, so we provide a way to avoid this situation
methods.description_zh: 当数据量非常大的时候，使用响应式数据会造成性能问题，所以我们提供了一种方式来规避这种情况

methods.name: scrollToNode
methods.description: scroll to a given tree key with specified scroll strategy
methods.params: (key: TreeKey, strategy?: auto | smart | center | start | end)
methods.description_zh: 滚动到指定树节点，支持不同的滚动策略

events.name: node-click
events.description: triggers when a node is clicked

events.name: node-drop
events.description: triggers when drag someting and drop on a node
events.description_zh: 拖拽并在节点上释放时触发的事件

events.name: node-contextmenu
events.description: triggers when a node is clicked by right button
events.description_zh: 当某一节点被鼠标右键点击时会触发该事件

events.name: check-change
events.description: triggers when the selected state of the node changes
events.description_zh: 节点选中状态发生变化时的回调

events.name: check
events.description: triggers after clicking the checkbox of a node
events.params: (data: TreeNodeData, info: { checkedKeys: TreeKey[],checkedNodes: TreeData, halfCheckedKeys: TreeKey[], halfCheckedNodes: TreeData,})
events.description_zh: 当复选框被点击的时候触发

events.name: current-change
events.description_zh: 当前选中节点变化时触发的事件

events.name: node-expand
events.description_zh: 节点被展开时触发的事件

events.name: node-collapse
events.description_zh: 节点被关闭时触发的事件

slots.name: default
slots.description: Custom content for tree nodes. The scope parameter is { node: TreeNode, data: TreeNodeData }
slots.description_zh: 自定义树节点的内容，参数为 { node: TreeNode, data: TreeNodeData }

slots.name: empty
slots.description: empty you can customize content when data is empty.
slots.description_zh: 数据为空时的自定义内容

props.name: value
props.description: unique identity key name for nodes, its value should be unique across the whole tree
props.description_zh: 节点唯一标识，整棵树应该是唯一的

props.name: label
props.description: specify which key of node object is used as the node's label
props.description_zh: 指定节点标签为节点对象的某个属性值

props.name: children
props.description: specify which node object is used as the node's subtree
props.description_zh: 指定子树为节点对象的某个属性值

props.name: disabled
props.description: specify which key of node object represents if node's checkbox is disabled
props.description_zh: 指定节点选择框是否禁用为节点对象的某个属性值
